calibration.source: p. 23, Fig. 11, left-hand graph; axes at tick marks, image width 1728 pixels
calibration.manual_method: Inspect black open-circle experimental markers on the blue dashed curve; select envelope turning points. Early overlapping curves excluded. Assign selected peaks to chronological Table 3 steps; assignments are inferred and load discrepancies retained.

rows.reason: Chronological envelope assignment to Table 3 load step; plot and table do not coincide exactly. Reading bounds include marker width, axis placement and local overlap; not statistical measurement errors.
